dedupe_keys.name: an sdn control plane for multiband networks exploiting a pli aware routing engine

description: Ramon Casellas and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The implemented control plane externalises physical-layer-impairment-aware routing, modulation and spectrum assignment. The authors describe TAPI data-model extensions and algorithms and validate the system in an emulated BT network containing 22 ROADMs. Coverage is that emulated multi-band infrastructure case. This record represents the implemented network-control model, not a general-purpose simulation platform or a proven deployment in live BT infrastructure. Source code availability and exact emulator configuration are not established by the abstract. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The fuller registered companion confirms transparent/translucent optimisation and the same 22-ROADM emulated BT validation.
